title: MOTION (RAMAN - PRICE) relative to funding for costs associated with the Summer 2026 Movies in the Park series and 2026 Back to School Backpack Drive.
text:
[Council File 26-1553; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RAMAN - PRICE) relative to funding for costs associated with the Summer 2026 Movies in the Park series and 2026 Back to School Backpack Drive.
Recommendation(s) for Council action: SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $6,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281204 (CD 4 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Neighborhood Council Fund No. 59B/14, Account No. 141269 (Sherman Oaks Neighborhood Council) for costs associated with their Summer 2026 Movies in the Park series ($4,800) and their 2026 Back to School Backpack Drive ($1,200).
2. AUTHORIZE the City Clerk to make corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically, or by any other means.
